newsitem.title: CANADA: Cambior targets 550,000 oz '97 gold output.
newsitem.headline: Cambior targets 550,000 oz '97 gold output.

text.p: Cambior Inc said on Thursday that it set a target of 550,000 ounces of gold production for 1997, versus 502,000 ounces produced in 1996.

The company's gold mining reserves grew by nine percent in 1996 to 6.1 millon ounces in situ. Its copper reserves totaled 11.2 million tonnes representing 25 billion pounds of copper in situ, Cambior said.

The company said it had a three-month production record of 155,000 ounces of gold in the fourth quarter, mainly because 93,000 ounces of gold were produced by an expanded mill at its Omai mine in Guyana.
